item.title: ‘YOU ARE GOING TO THINK I AM SILLY,’ ADMITS NANCY
item.description: WILFRIED NANCY faced a barrage of abuse from raging Celtic fans as he lost his fourth game in a row as the champions collapsed 2-1 to Dundee United at Tannadice last night. item.title: Laughing stock of football world
item.description: My friends in Celtic, we are the laughing stock of the football world. This status has been achieved by becoming the soft touches of Scottish football. item.title: ‘ABSOLUTELY SOLID,’ CELTIC SUPREMO BACKS UNDER-PRESSURE NANCY
item.description: UNDER-FIRE Wilfried Nancy will be given TWO transfer windows to put things right at Celtic. That’s the promise from chief-executive Michael Nicholson to the beleagured new Hoops manager who has seen the champions lose four consecutive games since his surprise appointment as long-term successor to Brendan Rodgers who resigned in late October. item.title: THE END IS IN SIGHT, WARNS SUTTON

item.title: CELTIC’S QUADRUPLE HEROES: WHERE ARE THEY NOW?
item.description: NEIL LENNON utilised 17 players when Celtic claimed a unique place in Scottish football history by sealing the phenomenal quadruple treble – exactly FIVE years ago today.
